sentimento.text1: With 65 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), the day's polling is Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, field Jul 26 to 28, 2.15pp margin, 95% confidence, BR-01084/2026): Lula 40.5% x Flávio Bolsonaro 31.2% in the first round, with Ronaldo Caiado 5.5%, Romeu Zema 3.2% and Renan Santos 3.0%. In the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), Lula 47.5% x Flávio 41.1%. That is a 9.3pp gap in the first round and 6.4pp in the runoff, and the runoff difference falls OUTSIDE the two margins added together, so this reading does not describe a statistical tie. Adding up the week, three houses measured the first-round gap at 9.1pp, 6pp and 9.3pp, which makes PoderData of Jul 30 the outlier, not Vox.
sentimento.text2: The day's cross-reading changed shape between the afternoon and the early evening. At 17:33 the front-runner was flat at 63.50%; in the 19:25 capture he ROSE 1.00pp to 64.50%, breaking a ceiling the AFOS series had been matching without exceeding on Jul 26, 28, 30 and 31. Flávio rose 0.40pp, to 24.35%, and even so the gap WIDENED from +39.55pp to +40.15pp, the widest since May 3, the start of the series that holds both names, and the first above 40pp. THREE consecutive institutes cut Renan Santos, and it is the sequence that matters, not the isolated figure: AtlasIntel 7.8% on Jul 29, PoderData 4% on Jul 30 and Vox Brasil 3.0% on Jul 31. With the price at 8.15%, the distance between market and poll reaches 5.15pp, the largest of the window. On Jul 29 the panel recorded that distance at 0.90pp and called it convergence. Three institutes later, it quadrupled.
sentimento.text3: In the market, Lula ROSE 1.00pp to 64.50% (vol USD 7.77M), the highest value in the AFOS series since Apr 14. Flávio rose 0.40pp, to 24.35% (vol USD 7.76M), and even so the gap WIDENED from +39.55pp to +40.15pp, because the front-runner rose more. Renan Santos fell 0.30pp, to 8.15% (vol USD 8.63M). Caiado fell 0.95pp against Jul 30, to 1.60% (vol USD 5.22M). Camilo Santana rose 0.85pp, to 1.35% (vol USD 4.17M), and Geraldo Alckmin stayed at 0.45% (vol USD 4.98M). Jair Bolsonaro fell to 0.85%, Zema fell 0.20pp to 0.35%, Haddad rose 0.10pp to 0.25%, Michelle stayed at 0.25% and Tereza Cristina at 0.20%. Tarcísio de Freitas remains at 0.15% (vol USD 13.68M), still the largest accumulated volume in the book. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market adds up to USD 117.06M.
sentimento.direita: Flávio rose 0.40pp, to 24.35% (vol USD 7.76M), and even so saw the gap WIDEN to +40.15pp, because Lula rose 1.00pp in the same session. In the sub-markets he FELL 0.50pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place book, to 78.50% (vol USD 216,000), and stayed at 5.65% in the third-place book. The counterpart to the fall in the second-place book is Renan Santos rising 3.25pp in that same contract, which suggests internal reallocation rather than a fresh reading on the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). In the polling, Vox has him at 31.2% in the first round and 41.1% in the runoff, with the 6.4pp difference falling outside the two margins added together. And his political day was one of doors closing, two of them. The PP announced NEUTRALITY in the election, saying it had consulted its state branches and decided not to call a National Convention, which blocks the ticket and rules out Tereza Cristina as running mate; the senator, who leads the PP in the Senate, shared the party statement and complied, and Flávio replied that he respects it and does not give up. Hours later, Republicanos called a national convention for Aug 4 with the majority of the state branches consulted defending neutrality, heading toward a refusal of the alliance. The verbs are not the same and the panel does not treat them as the same: the PP DECIDED, Republicanos has NOT yet decided. On Jul 24 this series recorded that, without the União-PP federation, Flávio was seeking Republicanos and Podemos. The Aug 5 deadline still has the running mate undefined.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula ROSE 1.00pp to 64.50% (vol USD 7.77M), passing for the first time since Apr 14 the 63.50% the series had been matching without breaking. The gap WIDENED to +40.15pp, the widest since May 3 and the first above 40pp, and it widened with Flávio ALSO rising, which describes demand for the front-runner and not deterioration of the opponent. In Vox Brasil he has 40.5% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47.5% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), with a 6.4pp advantage that falls outside the two margins added together. The institute records that, between May and July, Lula grew 7.3pp and Flávio fell 2.7pp in its own series, reversing an advantage that had been the senator's, and the panel reproduces this as a claim by the institute, because it is an internal comparison of theirs. In his camp, Camilo Santana rose 0.85pp, from 0.50% to 1.35%, and Alckmin stayed at 0.45%, on the day the PCdoB formalized support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket. The panel records the coincidence and does not assert cause. On Camilo, the series caveat is mandatory: 1.35% is NOT a record, his maximum is 4.10%, from May 3, and what happened was a recovery from the series MINIMUM, 0.50%, set on Jul 30. And his camp took a new judicial fact on the same day: the inquiry authorized by André Mendonça on Jul 30 to examine influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, with the Health Ministry and the Presidency. Lula said his son will have to prove his innocence and that he will not use his office to protect him.
sentimento.terceiraVia: The chasing pack had its busiest day of the week and no move points the same way. CAIADO fell 0.95pp against the 2.55% of Jul 30 and went to 1.60% (vol USD 5.22M), giving back more than the gain of two days, and at the same time ROSE 2.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book, to 27.50%. The series caveat does not soften the fall this time: 1.60% is his lowest value since Jul 22 and sits BELOW the 1.80% to 2.40% band in which he traded over that period, but it remains well above the series minimum, 0.90%, from Jul 9. In the polling, Vox gives him 5.5%, his best national reading of the window, above PoderData's 5% and well above AtlasIntel's 3.1%, and the divergence between institutes about him remains open at four levels within the same month. RENAN SANTOS fell 0.30pp in the winner contract, to 8.15% (vol USD 8.63M), but ROSE 3.25pp in the first-round second-place book, to 9.35%, recovering two thirds of what he had lost the day before. That is the contradiction of the day: the polling cuts him for the third consecutive institute and the money gives back part of the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) chance it had taken away 24 hours earlier. CAMILO SANTANA rose 0.85pp, to 1.35%. ZEMA fell 0.20pp, to 0.35%, in a fourth consecutive session of decline, on a day when Marcelo Aro left his Senate ticket to run for the state government of Minas Gerais, a move Zema publicly called betrayal.
sentimento.polymarket: Lula 64.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.77M), Flávio 24.35% (up 0.40pp, vol USD 7.76M), Renan Santos 8.15% (down 0.30pp, vol USD 8.63M), Caiado 1.60% (down 0.95pp, vol USD 5.22M), Camilo Santana 1.35% (up 0.85pp, vol USD 4.17M), Jair 0.85%, Alckmin 0.45% (vol USD 4.98M), Zema 0.35% (down 0.20pp), Haddad 0.25% (up 0.10pp), Michelle 0.25%, Tereza Cristina 0.20%, Tarcísio 0.15% (vol USD 13.68M). Lula's gap over Flávio at +40.15pp, against +39.55pp on Jul 30, the widest since May 3. Total accumulated volume in the presidential market at USD 117.06M. Sub-markets: [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place with Flávio 78.50% (down 0.50pp, vol USD 216,000), Renan Santos 9.35% (UP 3.25pp, vol USD 1.09M) and Lula 8.75%; third place with Renan 61.50% (vol USD 164,000), Caiado 27.50% (up 2.00pp, vol USD 37,000), Flávio 5.65% and Zema 4.45%; impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000); Senate with the PL at 72.00% (up 6.50pp, vol USD 258,000) and the MDB as a declared RANGE of 24.65% to 26.65%; inflation with the 5.00% to 5.49% band at 38.30% and the 4.50% to 4.99% band at 33.70% (up 1.20pp). The double-reading capture guard ran FOUR rounds today and failed all of them. The third failed precisely because Lula was in transit from 63.50% to 64.50%; the fourth repeated the entire presidential contract and failed a single book, the MDB in the Senate. That is why the presidential market goes in FIRM, including the 64.50%, and the MDB goes in as a declared RANGE of 24.65% to 26.65%. Live capture Jul 31, 22:25 UTC.

inss.text1: The fiscal agenda had routine new data and no political fact: the Central Bank released June statistics, with a primary deficit of R$ 55.3 billion in the month and gross debt rising above expectations, the day after the half-year result. The Senate remains in recess and the Budget remains the next front of friction with the government. The political day ran on ticket-building and on the judicial axis. The PP announced NEUTRALITY and vetoed the ticket that would have had Tereza Cristina as Flávio's running mate, Republicanos called a convention for Aug 4 heading toward the same refusal, and in the government camp Mendonça authorized on Jul 30 an inquiry into influence peddling by Lulinha. In Minas Gerais, Marcelo Aro left Romeu Zema's Senate ticket to run for the state government, and Zema called the move betrayal. The PCdoB formalized support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket.
inss.text2: The market changed shape between the afternoon and the early evening. At 17:33 the front-runner was flat at 63.50%; in the 19:25 capture Lula ROSE 1.00pp to 64.50%, breaking the top of the AFOS series, and Flávio rose 0.40pp, to 24.35%, with the gap WIDENING to +40.15pp. Renan fell 0.30pp, Caiado fell 0.95pp against Jul 30 and Camilo Santana rose 0.85pp. THREE consecutive institutes cut Renan Santos, and it is the sequence that matters, not the isolated figure: AtlasIntel 7.8% on Jul 29, PoderData 4% on Jul 30 and Vox Brasil 3.0% on Jul 31. With the price at 8.15%, the distance between market and poll reaches 5.15pp, the largest of the window. On Jul 29 the panel recorded that distance at 0.90pp and called it convergence. Three institutes later, it quadrupled.
inss.text3: The market for impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice was FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000), with no variation across the eight readings of today's four capture-guard rounds. A day with no fresh institutional fact on that axis, and the price matched the absence. With USD 83,000 of accumulated volume against USD 117.06M in the presidential market, this contract is only worth recording when it moves in a sustained way, and today it simply did not move.
inss.text4: In the Senate, the PL ROSE 6.50pp to 72.00% (vol USD 258,000), and the MDB goes in today as a declared RANGE, from 24.65% to 26.65%, because it was the only book the capture guard failed in the last round. Adding the two, the contract passes 97% of probability assigned to just two parties, which by itself indicates a wide spread in that book. In inflation, the modal band remains 5.00% to 5.49%, at 38.30%, and the 4.50% to 4.99% band rose 1.20pp, to 33.70%, in a book of USD 81,000 that is NOT covered by the guard. A large move in a small book is a record, not a signal.
inss.impactoLula: Vox Brasil of Jul 31 did not publish approval and disapproval in this round, so the evaluation picture remains the one from Jul 30, with the week's two opposite readings still standing: PoderData measured personal approval falling to 43% against 49% disapproval, and AtlasIntel, 24 hours earlier, measured it rising 1.7pp, to 47.6% against 51.2%. The panel continues to show AtlasIntel on the gauge, by the criterion it published on Jul 29, the largest sample and the smallest margin in the window. The week's band remains between 43% and 49%.
inss.impactoGestao: The Vox Brasil round of Jul 31 did NOT publish a management rating, so the picture remains the one from Jul 30 and the week's two readings still stand, pointing in opposite directions. PoderData of Jul 30 brought 34% good or very good, 16% fair and 47% poor or terrible, with poor or terrible rising 10pp against the institute's Jul 22 round. AtlasIntel of Jul 29 measured 49.3% poor or terrible, BTG/Nexus of Jul 27 measured 43% and Datafolha of Jul 24 measured 38%. The four institutes still agree on what matters most: management is rated worse than the person, and the distance between the two indicators persists.
inss.conclusao: With 65 days to the election, the day ended with the front-runner where he had never been: Lula rose 1.00pp to 64.50%, breaking the 63.50% the series had been matching without exceeding, and the gap went to +40.15pp, the widest since May 3 and the first above 40pp. The new poll, Vox Brasil of Jul 31 (n=2,100, field Jul 26 to 28, margin of 2.15pp, 95% confidence, BR-01084/2026), gives 40.5% x 31.2% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47.5% x 41.1% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and that 6.4pp difference falls outside the two margins added together, unlike what PoderData measured the day before. Three houses in the same week gave 9.1pp, 6pp and 9.3pp of first-round gap, and the panel records that the outlier is PoderData. THREE consecutive institutes cut Renan Santos, and with the price at 8.15% the distance between market and poll reaches 5.15pp, against the 0.90pp this panel called convergence on Jul 29. Politically, Flávio lost two doors on the same day, the PP by decision and Republicanos by signal, and the judicial axis produced the largest volume of new fact in the Master case since the inquiry was opened. None of these readings is attributed to a cause: the panel records that the price rose on the same day and does not claim it rose because of it.

bancoMaster.text1: Friday brought the largest volume of new fact in the Master case since the inquiry was opened, and the panel records that the reading published at 17:33, that the day had no new act, was wrong. André Mendonça lifted the secrecy of part of the investigation examining whether senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) received improper advantage to act in favor of Banco Master's interests in Senate matters. With the secrecy lifted, a Federal Police report became public identifying 74 calls between the senator and Augusto Lima, a former partner of the bank, between November 2023 and May 2025, adding up to more than five hours and thirty minutes of conversation across 555 days, the equivalent of one call every eight days.
bancoMaster.text2: The report also points to a preference by the senator and the former partner for voice calls inside messaging apps rather than text, a pattern that, according to the Federal Police, reduces the traceability of the interactions. In the same decision, Mendonça authorized the police to monitor the location of the senator's mobile phone, citing the risk of a leak of the operation and recording that Wagner requested a meeting in his office on the same day the police filed the request for the operation. Novo asked for proceedings to be opened against the senator in the Senate Ethics Council. Wagner publicly said he will prove his innocence. None of these acts is a conviction, and the panel does not treat them as such: they are an inquiry, a lifting of secrecy and a party petition.
bancoMaster.text3: On the legislative front there was no news, and the absence remains the fact. The writ of mandamus over the installation of the Banco Master CPI has been sitting for more than four months in Kassio Nunes Marques's office, and the request by four senators to remove him from the case was rejected. On price, the record is one of stillness: the market for impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice was FLAT at 3.10%, in a book of USD 83,000, with no variation across the eight readings of today's four guard rounds. It is worth underlining that this contract does NOT price the Wagner case, which runs against a senator and not against a justice, so a flat price there is not the market's answer to what came out today.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The fronts of the Master case run on separate tracks and should not be added together. The criminal one, at the STF under André Mendonça, gained on Friday its largest movement since it opened: secrecy lifted and a police report describing 74 contacts between the bank's former partner and a senator from the government's base, plus authorized monitoring of his mobile phone. The asset front continues in the Rio courts, with freezes. The legislative one has been stalled for more than four months in Nunes Marques's office. And there is a new front, which is not the Master case but shares the same rapporteur: the inquiry authorized on Jul 30 by Mendonça to examine influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, with the Health Ministry and the Presidency. The panel records that the same justice holds both investigations and draws from that no reading of intent.

stf.toffoli: Toffoli remains isolated at the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) after the Master crisis, with no fresh individual act captured on Friday.
stf.moraes: No new order from Moraes captured on Friday. The front he opened over the artificial-intelligence video shown at the PL convention remains live, with the 48-hour deadline already expired and the next decision pending.
stf.gilmar: No individual act from Gilmar in the period. The recent joint vote stands, with Dino, Moraes and Zanin, which reduced restrictions on penduricalhos.
stf.dino: No new act on Friday. Still running is the 10-day deadline set on Jul 29 for the government and Congress to specify the responsibility of members of Congress over earmarks.
stf.mendonca: He remains rapporteur of the inquiry opened on Jul 23 into Vorcaro's transfers for the film about Jair Bolsonaro, and on Friday he had the busiest day on the judicial axis. He lifted the secrecy of part of the investigation into senator Jaques Wagner in the Master case and authorized the Federal Police to monitor the location of the senator's mobile phone, citing the risk of a leak of the operation. On Jul 30 he had authorized the opening of an inquiry into influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha. The police assessment about asking Interpol to include Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro in the silver notice, recorded on Jul 30, remains an ASSESSMENT: the police have not asked and Interpol has not decided.
stf.nexo: Friday's connecting thread has two axes and they do not touch. On the PARTY axis, Flávio lost two doors on the same day: the PP announced NEUTRALITY in the election, saying it had consulted its state branches and decided not to call a National Convention, which blocks the ticket and rules out Tereza Cristina as running mate, and the senator complied; hours later, Republicanos called a convention for Aug 4 with the majority of the branches consulted defending neutrality, heading toward a refusal. The PP DECIDED, Republicanos has NOT yet. On the JUDICIAL axis, Mendonça lifted the secrecy of the investigation into Jaques Wagner in the Master case and authorized monitoring of the location of the senator's mobile phone, a day after authorizing the inquiry into Lulinha. On the other side, the PCdoB formalized support for the Lula-Alckmin ticket. The Aug 5 deadline for naming running mates organizes the coming days.
stf.analise: The market for impeachment of an [STF](/en/glossary#stf) justice before 2027 was FLAT at 3.10% (vol USD 83,000), with no variation across the eight readings of today's four capture-guard rounds. It is the second consecutive session at the same value, and it did not move on a day when the judicial axis produced plenty of fact, because none of those facts points to the removal of a justice: they examine a senator and a private individual, not a member of the Court. In a book of USD 83,000 against USD 117.06M in the presidential market, a flat price in the face of facts that do not touch the object of the contract is the expected behavior.
